name: newsgroup-update
description: Update one Tradebee news group with automatic pre-update backup.

language.description: Required exact enabled site language selected from languages-get; it must match the target news group.

newsgroup.description: Required update payload. Include newsgroup_id and only fields that should change.

newsgroup_id.description: Required positive news-group ID selected from newsgroup-read.

group_name.description: Optional new group name containing 2-300 characters. Omit it to keep the current name.

tags.description: Optional replacement array of 1-6 tags. Omit it to keep current tags.

brief_description.description: Optional new brief description, up to 300 characters. Omit it to keep the current value.

seo.description: Optional SEO fields to change. Omit this object or an individual field to keep its current value.

title.description: Optional new SEO title, up to 90 characters. Omit it to keep the current title.

description.description: Optional new SEO description, up to 200 characters. Omit it to keep the current description.

keywords.description: Optional new comma-separated SEO keywords, up to 6 keywords and 120 total characters. Omit it to keep current keywords.

confirmation.description: Required explicit approval covering update and backup.

approved.description: Must be true only after the user explicitly approves this operation.

summary.description: Summary of the exact language, update fields, and automatic backup approved by the user.

output.description: API result plus backup snapshot and restore payload.
